title: Ahaziah becomes king and is killed by Jehu
description: Ahaziah, the youngest son of Joram, was made king over Judah after his older brothers were killed by a band of raiders. He walked in the ways of the house of Ahab according to the counsel of his mother Athaliah. He went with Joram king of Israel against Hazael, king of Aram, and was eventually found hiding in Samaria and killed by Jehu, whom the Lord had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab [ref:2 Chr 22:1-9|2 Chronicles 22:1-9].
